The reason this should expand into:
(SETF X (FIXNUM-IDENTITY Y))
and NOT:
(FIXNUM-IDENTITY (SETF X Y))
(as it does now) is to check the fixnumitude of Y BEFORE storing it into
the fixnum variable X!  Please?
